rows.en: ...The Devil Gundam?
rows.notes: Question echo.

rows.en: That's right. A new model developed in the Neo Japan colony, the Ultimate Gundam...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing setup; next row explains.

rows.en: They say it went berserk for some reason.
It went berserk...
rows.notes: Echo of berserk report.

rows.en: A Mobile Fighter from the Neo Japan colony is pursuing it now, but apparently all sorts of obstacles are standing in the way.
That's where we, the Cry Wolves, come in.
Commander, do we know where the target is?
Yes. Major Urube Ishikawa of the Neo Japan colony military sent us data predicting where the target will appear.
And a weapon to stop it in its tracks: a special energy cannon.
Then are we deploying right away?
Yes. I'll brief Folia and the others on the mission too.
Assemble the squad in the briefing room.
Understood.
#男愛称...
rows.notes: Address only.

rows.en: What is it, sir?
...You're the man I discovered and trained. But you haven't been in actual combat for long yet...

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: Listen. Remember this one thing.
Within life, there is death. Within death, there is life...
Find a way to live in the midst of death. Carry out your assigned mission without fail, and make sure you come back alive.
Death has no meaning. Defeat the enemies you must defeat, and survive. Cling to life.
That is the iron rule of our Cry Wolves squad.
Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Military acknowledgement.

rows.en: Our next mission will be a difficult one...
But don't forget what you learned from the seated meditation training I made you do. Always keep your mind calm.
And make sure you come back alive with my son and my soldiers.
Yes, Commander...
rows.notes: Acknowledgement trailing into transition.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!

Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

No...! It can't be, not this!!

Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!

This is the end... and that's a wrap...

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!

Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...

Waaaah!! I-it's no good~

I'm bailing out!

uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

Could that cannon be causing it!?

uncertain: Hario and Karim are provisional source-name transliterations; independent English spellings and genders unestablished.

rows.notes: Officer briefing Ruri; source coast and Niigata example retained. Niigata spelling accepted by root from official city English.

rows.notes: Headquarters is explicitly the source decision-maker and task giver. Compressed only after measured four-line overflow: preliminary stage becomes prelude; retains headquarters, judgment, new enemy operation and our patrol assignment.

rows.en: Understood. I'll decide how to divide up our patrol sectors and inform everyone.
rows.notes: Ruri accepts and takes responsibility for sector allocation and notification.

rows.en: ...So you and #男愛称's team will be responsible for patrolling the Niigata area.
rows.notes: Rose briefs Dragonar pilots; plural team includes both protagonists. Niigata spelling accepted by root from official city English.

rows.en: Niigata?
rows.notes: Deliberate location-only echo. Niigata spelling accepted by root from official city English.

rows.en: It's a city on the Sea of Japan coast. But I heard Giganos forces attacked it before...
rows.notes: Light supplies geography and prior attack, trailing off for Linda.

rows.en: Yes... It's deserted now.
rows.notes: Linda confirms the earlier attack and present depopulation.

rows.en: So those Giganos bastards might be coming there from across the sea, huh?
rows.notes: Kaine infers likely approach across the sea; insult retained.

rows.en: That's right... They still have forward bases on the mainland.
rows.notes: Mainland forward bases explain the possibility.

rows.en: Don't tell me that Gon Jem Squad is coming?

rows.notes: Deliberate concessive ending hands reasoning to Light.

rows.notes: Viper metaphor and abnormal persistence retained.

rows.notes: Coined romance slang adapted; same phrase in82/92.
uncertain: Coined doki-love slang adapted as heart-throb love; no established licensed wording.

rows.notes: Expands the slang into fluttery/lovey-dovey components.
uncertain: Coined doki-love slang adapted as heart-throb love; no established licensed wording.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly.
What century are you from?

rows.en: What's wrong with that? You guys had better not get in our way, okay?

rows.notes: Rose plus D-3 route the support traffic; audible-to-all joke retained.

rows.en: Tch, what's up with that?

rows.notes: Context: battle confrontation/rescue; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Get to it, you bastards! Earn yourselves tomorrow's meal money!!
rows.notes: Context: battle confrontation/rescue; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: All enemy machine signatures have disappeared.
rows.notes: Context: battle confrontation/rescue; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Then recover all our machines... We'll leave security in this area to the Earth Federation Army units and withdraw.
rows.notes: Context: battle confrontation/rescue; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Kaine! I'm so glad you're safe...!
rows.notes: Linda expresses relief to Kaine; I restored.

rows.en: Yeah. You think we'd go down that easily?
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Still, we really managed to hit the jackpot, didn't we...
rows.notes: Ironic jackpot refers to encountering Gon Jem Squad.

rows.en: Yeah. The Gon Jem Squad hadn't given up on coming after us.
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: We'd better assume they'll keep showing up in the Japan area.
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: ...By the way, is #男愛称 all right?
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Well... He says he absolutely refuses to get treatment...
rows.notes: Trailing delivery preserved; male lead is the refuser.

rows.en: Something like this happened to him before, didn't it?
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Yeah... He seemed to be all right for a while, though...
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: And it looked like he took some medicine during the battle...
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: He said before that he had a chronic illness. Is that what caused this?
rows.notes: Both clauses refer to male lead.

rows.en: If that were really true, he wouldn't be chosen as a test pilot...
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Yeah. Normally, he'd have to have a physical examination beforehand.
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: Maybe he suffered a serious injury a long time ago or something...
rows.notes: Speculative trailing delivery preserved with he restored.

rows.en: Then he'd be even less likely to be chosen.
rows.notes: Test-pilot selection predicate restored from Ple Two 310.

rows.en: But there's Kazuya's case. You can't say that applies to everyone, can you?
rows.notes: Kazuya is an exception to the injury/selection argument.

rows.en: Huh? He went through something like that...!?
rows.notes: He refers to Kazuya.

rows.en: Yeah. He had a serious accident during training that left his whole body paralyzed...
rows.notes: He refers to Kazuya; complete paralysis retained.
Retained source nonverbal reaction.

rows.en: But he made a remarkable recovery after some grueling rehabilitation.
rows.notes: He refers to Kazuya.

rows.en: Still, #男愛称's case seems to be different...
rows.notes: Context: postbattle group discussion; source-settled subjects and spoken register retained.

rows.en: I knew it... There's something about #男愛称's body...
rows.notes: Source thought trails off; stray closing wrapper and @ indent ignored.
uncertain: The nature of the problem in the male lead's body remains deliberately unspecified; no diagnosis added.

rows.en: The pain is easing... But what on earth is happening...?
Could my body have reached its limit, just as Zapat said...?
rows.notes: Source-short Zapat preserved under explicit fixed-spelling exception.

rows.en: #男愛称, I'm asking you this as your partner.
What exactly is that medicine? Why do you have to take it?
Answer me! This isn't just your problem!
Please move aside. I've got something to do.
Something to do...! Something you can't even tell me about?!
rows.notes: Question answers his stated errand; even his partner is excluded.

rows.en: Yeah.
Y-you...! Enough with all this secrecy!!
Fine! I won't ask you anymore! Do whatever you want!
...I'm sorry, #女愛称...
rows.notes: Personal apology with restored I; directed inward toward female partner.

rows.en: But... I can't let you find out what's wrong with my body...
Honestly...! What's with him...! Why does he go so far...
rows.notes: Final clause deliberately trails off; him is the male protagonist, established by #男愛称.

rows.en: ...You're pretty upset, #女愛称.
Oh... Rain...
I think I understand a little of how you feel.
Huh...?
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: Domon used to be... just like that.
Domon did...?
rows.notes: Referent of that person is Domon, named in previous line.

rows.en: Yes... As you know, Domon bore a cruel fate, fighting Master and the Devil Gundam...
rows.notes: Master retained as source-short personal designation; Domon explicitly subject.

rows.en: I went along with him as his partner, but...
rows.notes: Source trails off; stray closing wrapper and @ ignored per brief.

rows.en: At first, he wouldn't tell me much.
Domon does have trouble expressing himself... But because of that, we clashed over and over...
rows.notes: Repeated clashes preserve source repetition; Domon sourced male profile.

rows.en: There were times I doubted whether he really thought of me as his partner.
But after that whole incident was over... I realized something.
In his own way, he was trying to keep me from worrying about him more than I had to...
rows.notes: Rain realizes Domon intended to spare unnecessary worry; intention, not a claim that worry vanished.

rows.en: ...I think #男愛称 will tell you about himself too, when the time comes.
rows.notes: Runtime male nickname retained; time comes governs disclosure.

rows.en: So for now, think about what you can do... to help him.
To... help #男愛称...
rows.notes: Deliberate echo fragment of Rain suggestion; no complete assertion invented.

rows.en: I think a relationship where you can tell each other anything is wonderful, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately suspended contrast continued by next row.

rows.en: Isn't it also important for partners to understand each other's feelings and quietly support each other?
rows.notes: Reciprocal partner advice preserves sensing feelings plus quiet support.

rows.en: ...I understand, Rain.
There are still plenty of times when I don't know what he's thinking, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately suspended contrast continued by next row.

rows.en: I'll think about what I need to do so the two of us can get proper results together.
Besides, I'm older... I need to look after him.
rows.notes: Female partner is older and takes responsibility; age subject restored as I.

rows.en: #女愛称...
Like I said before, I'll... wait until he's ready to tell me.
rows.notes: Earlier-stated willingness to wait retained; no deadline invented.

rows.en: You really pushed yourself too far, #男愛称.
I don't want to hear your lectures. Give me the medicine already.
Oh...? Are you sure you can afford to take that tone with me?
The only way for you to survive is to take the medicine I made.
Or would you like to try fighting Medius without it?
rows.notes: Source-short Medius retained, not expanded to Medius Locus.

rows.en: But if anything happens to me and #機体名, you're the one who'll be in trouble.
rows.notes: Threat concerns male pilot and runtime-named machine.

rows.en: Unless... you've been secretly working with Albero. Then it's a different story.
I'm the victim here, you know? Your former superior stole my precious prototype, and disrupted the project's progress.
Besides... I'm the one who saved you. Have you forgotten what you owe me?
I don't remember ever asking you to save me...!
Very well... It's true I'd be in trouble if anything happened to any of you.
rows.notes: Plural you preserved without restricting the group to pilot/machine; response follows his threat about himself and his machine.
uncertain: Exact scope of plural you is not explicit: it may include the partner as well as the male pilot. Translation leaves the group open.

rows.en: To escape the sponsor's scrutiny, I need better results than ever before...
rows.notes: Unfinished transition into367 retained; sponsor possessive unspecified, so no shared our added.

rows.en: I must complete a new TE Absorber model based on data from your machine, you see.
rows.notes: Your machine data are basis for new TE Absorber model; English your preserves source plural possessor without inventing identities.

rows.en: A new model...?!
I'll arrange for new medicine right away. It should keep you going for the time being.
But unless you let me adjust your body, the same thing will keep happening.
rows.notes: Adjustment targets protagonist body in medical context; no mechanism invented.

rows.en: As I've told you before, I have no intention of doing that.
I see. But if you change your mind, let me know anytime.
For the sake of the new model, I can't afford to lose you.
A new TE Absorber model...
rows.notes: Deliberate reflection fragment on newly disclosed model.

rows.en: Are you saying I'm only useful to you until it's finished, Zapat...?!
rows.notes: Useful value lasts until completion, phrased as suspicious question; short Zapat preserved.

rows.en: Dr. Zapat has contacted us. He says he'll give him an additional supply of medicine.
rows.notes: He in first sentence is Zapat; recipient in second is male protagonist. Two subjects kept distinct.

rows.en: I see. Now he can fight me.
rows.notes: He refers to male protagonist; Albero is opponent.
Silence fits events5/14/15.

rows.en: Let me ask you something. You really do intend to defeat him, don't you?
Of course.
rows.notes: Context checked against original numeric scene order and neighboring replies; full meaning retained.

rows.en: What are you doing it for?
rows.notes: Question asks purpose of defeating protagonist, not method.

rows.en: I've already told you. To get revenge on that Devil Gundam... and surpass it.
rows.notes: It refers to Devil Gundam, directly named and antecedent of surpass.

rows.en: ...Understood.
Yes... Revenge... Surpassing it...
rows.notes: Deliberate three-part reflection with nominal fragments retained.

rows.en: But that isn't all I have to do.
Until I achieve my true purpose... I'll make use of you, Eldy Middi. And AI1...
rows.notes: True purpose unspecified; full source Eldy Middi and AI1 preserved.

rows.en: No matter what power you may have hidden within you.
rows.notes: You addresses AI1, immediate prior thought addressee; gender-neutral.
